_source: MERC MYT Order for MSEDCL, press note (March 2025), Annexure 3 (LT tariff FY 2026-27) and Section 12 (ToD slabs). Check the latest MSEDCL tariff booklet before quoting; later review orders (Case 75 of 2025) may have changed these.
_note: Energy + wheeling charges only. Electricity duty and fuel adjustment charge (FAC) are NOT included, so the bill shown is an underestimate of the real printed bill.

tod.applies_to: LT-Domestic consumers billed on a ToD / smart meter
tod._note: Rebate is Rs 0.80/kWh in FY26 rising to Rs 1.00/kWh by FY30. No peak surcharge for residential (Note-3 of the ToD table).
